Package io.github.jabrena.juno.linker

package io.github.jabrena.juno.linker
Closed-world reachability: starting at main, follows every statically resolvable call, resolves hardware intrinsics and record accessors, and rejects anything reachable that falls outside Juno's supported subset — before any code generation is attempted.

Linker performs the reachability walk and produces a Program: the entry point, every reachable LinkedMethod, every loaded class (needed so lowering can resolve fields on classes never themselves called into), the resolved Board target, and an optional watchdog timeout. Descriptor parses JVM method/field descriptor strings, and RecordSupport is the cheap structural check that lets a record accessor call through the reachability scan without linking its trivial compiler-generated body.

Unreachable methods are simply omitted from Program, which is how Juno keeps generated firmware limited to what a program actually calls.

    LinkedMethod
     
    Linker
    Performs closed-world reachability and resolves every static call before code generation.
    Program
    classes is every class loaded from the classpath (not just reachable methods' owners) — needed so that lowering can resolve a getstatic on an enum constant field to its ordinal, since the field's owner class may differ from the reachable method's own owner and is otherwise never visited (its <clinit>/<init>/values()/etc. are deliberately never added to methods).
    RecordSupport
    A cheap, purely structural check (name + zero-arg descriptor against a record's component list) used by the linker's reachability scan to avoid rejecting a record accessor call as "not a Juno intrinsic" before it ever reaches lowering.
